family_policy: useful technical/functional families may contain multiple exact PNs; exact PN usage is separately preserved and ranked
fuse_policy: same-spec alternate/substitute fuse PNs may share one functional family while remaining distinct PN usage groups
pn_policy: likely PN may normalize spacing/punctuation and recurrence-supported OCR variation; all observed raw PN strings remain preserved
quantity_policy: sum explicit numeric quantities only; never estimate unstated quantities
